nodes.label: Multi-Tenant RLS Strategy
nodes.rationale: Shared database with tenant_id column and PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) policies for hard tenant boundaries and cost-effectiveness.

nodes.label: Gateway-Ready Monorepo Architecture
nodes.rationale: Every module is a self-contained Express router to allow future extraction into microservices behind an API Gateway with zero business logic changes.

nodes.label: Express 5
nodes.rationale: Chosen over Fastify for portability of routers; Express routers are self-contained and easily extractable into standalone services.

nodes.label: React 19 + Vite 6
nodes.rationale: Pure SPA architecture preferred over Next.js to avoid SSR complexity and maintain full decoupling from the API.

nodes.label: Drizzle ORM
nodes.rationale: Lightweight TypeScript-native ORM that generates raw SQL without the bloat of Prisma.
